session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Big Gap Up but Still Inside Bear Channel' (ET+12 hrs, Mar 30/31; inset Bear Channel Continues T-F-M). Gap up and opening reversal off 6470, shaded trading range with the double bottom but trading range and 2nd leg down likely note and 50% pullback at 6453, the double top at 6458 kicking off the tight bear channel decline with consecutive wedges to the 6358 low (opening range measured move at 6350), and an end of day reversal rally stopped by Friday's low resistance into the 6378 close.
